dismissed.title: Whitespace-only edit to an untouched line (final newline)
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. The final-newline edit is required: .editorconfig sets insert_final_newline = true, and dotnet format --verify-no-changes on the changed file needs it. The Implementation Notes record it as a deviation. This is not an unrelated change.
